title: 被动语态（复杂时态）
explanation: 被动语态可与多种时态、情态动词结合使用，不仅限于一般现在时和一般过去时。此外还可用于含双宾语、宾语补足语等复杂句型中。by 短语在不重要或显而易见时可省略。
rules: 现在完成时被动：have/has been + p.p.
过去完成时被动：had been + p.p.
将来时被动：will be + p.p.
情态动词被动：can/must/should + be + p.p.
进行时被动：is/am/are being + p.p.
含不定式的被动：to be + p.p.

examples.en: The project has been completed ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 这个项目已提前完成。

examples.en: The building is being constructed right now.
examples.zh: 这栋建筑正在建设中。

examples.en: The report must be submitted by Friday.
examples.zh: 报告必须在周五前提交。

exercises.question: The email ___ (send) an hour ago.
The walls ___ (paint) right now.
找出错误并选择正确说法：The homework must been finished by tomorrow.
exercises.answer: The homework must be finished by tomorrow.
options: The homework must been finished by tomorrow.
The homework must be finished by tomorrow.
The homework must is finished by tomorrow.

title: 关系从句（限制性与非限制性）
explanation: 限制性关系从句是先行词不可缺少的修饰部分，不用逗号隔开；非限制性关系从句提供补充信息，去掉后不影响句子基本含义，用逗号隔开。非限制性从句不能用 that 引导。
rules: 限制性关系从句：无逗号，可用 that
非限制性关系从句：用逗号隔开，不能用 that
非限制性可修饰整个主句：..., which is great.
who/whom/which/whose 在两种从句中均可使用
非限制性关系从句翻译时常另起一句

examples.en: The car that/which I bought is red.
examples.zh: 我买的那辆车是红色的。（限制性）

examples.en: My car, which is red, is parked outside.
examples.zh: 我的车是红色的，停在外面。（非限制性）

examples.en: She passed the exam, which surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 她通过了考试，这让所有人都很惊讶。（非限制性修饰整句）

exercises.question: The book ___ I lent you is very interesting.
My brother, ___ lives in London, is a doctor.
找出错误并选择正确说法：My house, that is blue, is on the corner.
exercises.answer: My house, which is blue, is on the corner.
options: My house, that is blue, is on the corner.
My house, which is blue, is on the corner.
My house, what is blue, is on the corner.

title: 虚拟条件句（混合条件句）
explanation: 混合条件句将过去与现在的虚拟混合使用。常见形式：If + 过去完成时, would + 动词原形（过去的原因影响现在的结果），或 If + 过去式, would have + p.p.（现在的假设影响过去的结果）。
rules: If + had + p.p., would + 动词原形：过去对现在的影响
If + 过去式, would have + p.p.：现在对过去的影响
If + had + p.p., could/might/should + 动词原形
wish 后也可使用混合条件：I wish I had studied harder.（过去→现在）

examples.en: If I had studied harder, I would be a doctor now.
examples.zh: 如果我当时更努力学习，我现在就是医生了。

examples.en: If I were braver, I would have spoken up yesterday.
examples.zh: 如果我更勇敢一点，我昨天就该说出来。

examples.en: If she hadn't missed the train, she would be here with us.
examples.zh: 如果她没错过火车，她现在就和我们在一起了。

exercises.question: If I ___ (study) harder, I would be a lawyer now.
If he ___ (be) more careful, he wouldn't have made that mistake.
找出错误并选择正确说法：If I would have known, I would come earlier.
exercises.answer: If I had known, I would have come earlier.
options: If I would have known, I would come earlier.
If I had known, I would have come earlier.
If I knew, I would come earlier.

title: 情态动词完成时
explanation: 情态动词 + have + 过去分词用于对过去事件的推测、后悔或批评。must have done 表示过去一定发生了，can't have done 表示过去不可能发生，should have done 表示过去本应做但没做。
rules: must have + p.p.：过去一定做了某事
can't/couldn't have + p.p.：过去不可能做了某事
should/ought to have + p.p.：过去本应做但没做
needn't have + p.p.：过去没必要做但做了
could have + p.p.：过去本可以做但没做

examples.en: He must have forgotten about the meeting.
examples.zh: 他一定是忘了会议。

examples.en: You should have told me earlier.
examples.zh: 你应该早点告诉我的。

examples.en: She can't have said that. She's too polite.
examples.zh: 她不可能说那种话。她很有礼貌。

exercises.question: He ___ (must forget) the meeting. He didn't come.
You ___ (should have told) me about this sooner.
找出错误并选择正确说法：She can't have went there alone.
exercises.answer: She can't have gone there alone.
options: She can't have went there alone.
She can't have gone there alone.
She can't has gone there alone.

title: 名词性从句
explanation: 名词性从句在句子中充当名词的角色，包括主语从句、宾语从句、表语从句和同位语从句。常用引导词：that, whether, what, who, which, when, where, how, why 等。
rules: 主语从句：That he passed the exam surprised us.
宾语从句：I think (that) he is right.
表语从句：The problem is that we don't have enough money.
whether 引导的从句可充当多种名词成分
what = the thing that，自带先行词

examples.en: That she left early was strange.
examples.zh: 她早早离开这件事很奇怪。

examples.en: I don't know whether he will come.
examples.zh: 我不知道他是否会来。

examples.en: The truth is that nobody knows.
examples.zh: 事实是没人知道。

exercises.question: ___ he said was not true.
I wonder ___ she will come on time.
把单词排序成正确的句子（名词性从句：1. The fact 2. is 3. that 4. nobody 5. knows）。
exercises.answer: the fact is that nobody knows

title: 倒装句
explanation: 倒装句是将正常语序的主谓顺序颠倒。分为完全倒装（整个谓语在主语前）和部分倒装（助动词在主语前）。否定词或副词前置常触发部分倒装。
rules: 否定词前置：Never / Rarely / Hardly / Seldom + 助动词 + 主语
Not only...but also 倒装前半部分：Not only did she..., but she also...
No sooner...than / Hardly...when：过去完成倒装
Only + 状语前置：Only then did I realize...
完全倒装：Here/There + 动词 + 主语（名词时）

examples.en: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
examples.zh: 我从未见过如此美丽的日落。

examples.en: Not only did she pass the exam, but she also got top marks.
examples.zh: 她不仅通过了考试，还取得了最高分。

examples.en: Here comes the bus.
examples.zh: 公交车来了。

exercises.question: Rarely ___ (have / has) he made such a mistake.
Only after the meeting ___ I realize how important it was.
找出错误并选择正确说法：Never I have seen such a sunset.
exercises.answer: Never have I seen such a sunset.
options: Never I have seen such a sunset.
Never have I seen such a sunset.
Never have seen I such a sunset.

title: 强调句
explanation: 强调句用于突出句子中的某个成分（主语、宾语、状语等）。基本结构为 It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其余部分。判断方法：去掉 It is/was...that 后句子仍完整。
rules: It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 剩余部分
强调人时可用 who 代替 that
强调时间、地点、原因时仍用 that 不用 when/where/why
否定强调：It was not until...that...
强调句的 be 动词时态与原句一致

examples.en: It was Tom who/that broke the window.
examples.zh: 是汤姆打碎了窗户。

examples.en: It is in this room that we had the meeting.
examples.zh: 我们就是在这个房间开的会。

examples.en: It was not until midnight that he finished the work.
examples.zh: 他直到半夜才完成工作。

exercises.question: It was ___ I arrived home that I realized I had left my keys.
It ___ Tom who broke the window.
把单词排序成正确的句子（强调句：1. It 2. was 3. yesterday 4. that 5. she 6. arrived）。
exercises.answer: it was yesterday that she arrived

title: 现在完成时 vs 过去完成时
explanation: 现在完成时以现在为参照点，过去完成时以过去某一时刻为参照点。过去完成时表示过去的过去。在叙述中，过去完成时用于建立事件的先后顺序。
rules: 现在完成时：have/has + p.p.，参照点是现在
过去完成时：had + p.p.，参照点是过去某一时刻
叙述故事中先发生的事用过去完成时
by + 过去时间点后用过去完成时
by + 现在时间点后用现在完成时

examples.en: I have read that book. (现在读完了)
examples.zh: 我已经读过那本书了。

examples.en: When I arrived, she had already left. (先离开后到达)
examples.zh: 当我到达时，她已经离开了。

examples.en: By 2020, I had worked for five companies.
examples.zh: 到2020年为止，我已在五家公司工作过。

exercises.question: When I arrived, the movie ___ (start) already.
I ___ (live) in this city for ten years now.
找出错误并选择正确说法：By the time she came, I have finished my work.
exercises.answer: By the time she came, I had finished my work.
options: By the time she came, I have finished my work.
By the time she came, I had finished my work.
By the time she came, I finished my work.

title: 条件句（if 不真实条件）
explanation: if 引导的条件句分为真实条件句和非真实（虚拟）条件句。虚拟条件句表达与事实相反的假设，时态需后退。与现在相反用过去式，与过去相反用过去完成时。
rules: 与现在事实相反：If + 过去式, would/could/might + 动词原形
与过去事实相反：If + had + p.p., would/could/might + have + p.p.
与将来事实相反（可能性小）：If + should/were to + 动词原形
If I were you...（be 动词用 were）
倒装：Had I known = If I had known

examples.en: If I won the lottery, I would travel the world.
examples.zh: 如果我中了彩票，我会环游世界。

examples.en: If we had left earlier, we wouldn't have been late.
examples.zh: 如果我们早点出发，就不会迟到了。

examples.en: Had I known, I would have come.
examples.zh: 如果我当时知道，我就会来了。

exercises.question: If I ___ (have) more money, I would buy a house.
If she ___ (study) harder, she would have passed the exam.
找出错误并选择正确说法：If I would have known, I would help you.
exercises.answer: If I had known, I would have helped you.
options: If I would have known, I would help you.
If I had known, I would have helped you.
If I knew, I would help you.

title: 分词作状语
explanation: 分词（现在分词或过去分词）可以充当状语，表示时间、原因、条件、伴随等。其逻辑主语应与主句主语一致。现在分词表主动，过去分词表被动。
rules: 现在分词（-ing）：表主动或同时进行
过去分词（-ed）：表被动或已完成
分词状语放在句首，用逗号与主句隔开
逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致
完成式分词：Having + p.p. 强调先后

examples.en: Walking along the street, I met an old friend.
examples.zh: 走在街上时，我遇到了一位老朋友。

examples.en: Tired from the journey, she went to bed early.
examples.zh: 旅途劳累，她早早上床睡觉了。

examples.en: Having finished the report, he went home.
examples.zh: 完成报告后，他回家了。

exercises.question: ___ (see) the movie, I went home.
___ (tire) of the noise, she closed the window.
找出错误并选择正确说法：Running in the park, the rain started.
exercises.answer: Running in the park, I got caught in the rain.
options: Running in the park, the rain started.
Running in the park, I got caught in the rain.
Running in the park, rain started.

title: 现在完成进行时
explanation: 现在完成进行时强调“从过去某一时刻一直持续到现在”的动作，结构为 have/has been doing。
rules: have/has been + 动词ing
强调持续性与未完成
常搭配 for / since

examples.en: I have been learning English for five years.
examples.zh: 我学英语已经五年了。

examples.en: It has been raining all morning.
examples.zh: 整个上午一直在下雨。

exercises.question: She has been ___ (work) here since 2019.
找出错误：He has been run for an hour.
exercises.answer: He has been running for an hour
options: He has been running for an hour
He has been run for an hour
He has running for an hour

title: 虚拟语气（第二类）
explanation: 第二类虚拟条件句描述与现在事实相反的假设：if 从句用过去式，主句用 would + 动词原形。
rules: if 从句：动词过去式
be 动词统一用 were
主句：would / could / might + 动词原形

examples.en: If I were you, I would study harder.
examples.zh: 如果我是你，我会更努力学习。

examples.en: If he had time, he would help us.
examples.zh: 如果他有时间，他会帮我们的。

exercises.question: If I ___ a bird, I would fly everywhere.
找出错误：If I was you, I would go.
exercises.answer: If I were you, I would go
options: If I were you, I would go
If I was you, I would go
If I were you, I will go

title: 过去完成时
explanation: 过去完成时表示“过去的过去”：在过去某动作发生时，另一动作已经完成，结构为 had + 过去分词。
rules: had + 过去分词
常搭配 before, by the time
与一般过去时共同构成时间先后

examples.en: The train had left before I arrived.
examples.zh: 我到之前火车已经开了。

examples.en: By then, she had already gone home.
examples.zh: 到那时她早已回家了。

exercises.question: When we got there, the film ___ (start).
找出错误：I had saw the news before dinner.
exercises.answer: I had seen the news before dinner
options: I had seen the news before dinner
I had saw the news before dinner
I have seen the news before dinner

title: 被动语态（一般过去）
explanation: 一般过去的被动语态表达“过去被…”，结构为 was/were + 过去分词。
rules: was/were + 过去分词
was 用于单数，were 用于复数
由 by 引出施事者

examples.en: The bridge was built in 1920.
examples.zh: 这座桥建于 1920 年。

examples.en: These songs were written by her.
examples.zh: 这些歌是她写的。

exercises.question: The letters ___ (send) yesterday.
找出错误：The window was broke last night.
exercises.answer: The window was broken last night
options: The window was broken last night
The window was broke last night
The window is broken last night

title: 宾语从句
explanation: 宾语从句作动词或介词的宾语，用 that/whether 或疑问词引导，从句用陈述语序。
rules: 引导词：that / whether / what / how…
从句用陈述语序
时态随主句调整

examples.en: I think that he is right.
examples.zh: 我认为他是对的。

examples.en: Do you know where the station is?
examples.zh: 你知道车站在哪吗？

exercises.question: 排序：I / that / believe / he / is honest
exercises.answer: I believe that he is honest
options: I believe that he is honest
I believe he that is honest
That he is honest I believe

exercises.question: I don’t know ___ he will come.

title: 分词作状语
explanation: 分词短语可以作状语表示原因、时间或伴随情况，逻辑主语须与主句主语一致。
rules: -ing 表示主动、同时发生
-ed 表示被动或状态
置于句首或句中

examples.en: Tired of waiting, he left.
examples.zh: 等得不耐烦，他离开了。

examples.en: Walking in the park, I met an old friend.
examples.zh: 在公园散步时，我遇到了一位老朋友。

exercises.question: ___ (see) the danger, he stopped quickly.
找出错误：Surprising by the news, she stayed quiet.
exercises.answer: Surprised by the news, she stayed quiet
options: Surprised by the news, she stayed quiet
Surprising by the news, she stayed quiet
Surprise by the news, she stayed quiet

title: 倒装句
explanation: 否定性副词（never, hardly, seldom 等）置于句首时，主谓用部分倒装，表示强调。
rules: 否定词 + 助动词 + 主语 + 谓语
常见词：never, hardly, not only
通常带“也/从不”等强调语气

examples.en: Never have I seen such a view.
examples.zh: 我从未见过这样的景色。

examples.en: Hardly did he notice the change.
examples.zh: 他几乎没注意到变化。

exercises.question: 排序：I / have / never / such a view / seen
exercises.answer: Never have I seen such a view
options: Never have I seen such a view
I never have seen such a view
Never I have seen such a view

exercises.question: 找出错误：Never I have heard such a story.
exercises.answer: Never have I heard such a story
options: Never have I heard such a story
Never I have heard such a story
Never I heard have such a story

title: 惯用搭配（get / have / make）
explanation: get / have / make 与名词或非谓语构成高频固定搭配，表达“使…”“得到…”等含义。
rules: make a decision 做决定
get along 相处 / 进展
have a talk 交谈

examples.en: Let’s make a decision today.
examples.zh: 我们今天做个决定吧。

examples.en: They get along well with each other.
examples.zh: 他们相处得很好。

exercises.question: I need to have a ___ with my boss.
找出错误：Let’s make decide today.
